def build_breadcrumb(route_prefix, effective_path, host_display):
    prefix = route_prefix or ""
    trimmed = effective_path.strip('/')
    if not trimmed:
        return f'<span><bdi>{escape_html(host_display)}</bdi></span>/'
    parts = trimmed.split('/')
    crumb = f'<a href="{prefix}/"><bdi>{escape_html(host_display)}</bdi></a>/'
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        is_last = i == len(parts)-1
        path_up_to = '/' + '/'.join(parts[:i+1]) + '/'
        href = prefix + path_up_to
        if is_last:
            crumb += f'<span><bdi>{escape_html(part)}</bdi></span>/'
        else:
            crumb += f'<a href="{href}"><bdi>{escape_html(part)}</bdi></a>/'
    return crumb

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts = s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username": parts[0], "type": None, "hash": ""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username": parts[0], "type": None, "hash": parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username": parts[0], "type": parts[1], "hash": parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username": parts[0], "type": parts[1], "hash": ':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username": parts[0], "type": None, "hash": ':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, password):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"] == password
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest() == entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(password.encode()).hexdigest() == entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

class RequestHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    # We'll use class variables to store config
    config = None
    serve_path = None
    serve_path_is_file = False

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Override to control verbose logging
        if self.config and self.config.get("verbose"):
            # Original logs like: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 19:36:19 +0000 [INFO] 127.0.0.1 "GET /file.txt HTTP/1.1" 200 12 "-" "curl/7.81.0" 0.000268
            # We'll approximate
            client_ip = self.client_address[0]
            method = self.command
            path = self.path
            status = args[1] if len(args)>1 else 200
            size = args[2] if len(args)>2 else 0
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            # Try to get user-agent and referer from headers
            ua = self.headers.get('User-Agent','-')
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {client_ip} "{method} {path} {self.request_version}" {status} {size} "-" "{ua}" 0.000000\n')
        # Suppress default

    def do_GET(self):
        self.handle_method("GET")
    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.handle_method("HEAD")
    def do_POST(self):
        self.handle_method("POST")
    def do_PROPFIND(self):
        self.handle_method("PROPFIND")

    def handle_method(self, method):
        # Parse url
        from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, unquote
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        raw_path_full = self.path  # includes query
        path_part = parsed.path
        query_string = parsed.query
        query_params = parse_qs(query_string)
        # flatten: take first value
        query_flat = {k: v[0] for k, v in query_params.items()}

        # effective path handling route prefix
        effective_path = path_part
        route_prefix = self.config.get("route_prefix")
        if route_prefix:
            rp = route_prefix
            if effective_path == rp:
                effective_path = "/"
            elif effective_path.startswith(rp + "/"):
                effective_path = effective_path[len(rp):]
                if not effective_path.startswith('/'):
                    effective_path = '/' + effective_path
            else:
                # 404 route not found
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, is_route_mismatch=True)
                return

        # Auth check
        if self.config.get("auth_entries"):
            auth_header = self.headers.get('Authorization')
            authorized = False
            if auth_header and auth_header.lower().startswith('basic '):
                b64 = auth_header[6:].strip()
                try:
                    decoded = base64.b64decode(b64).decode('utf-8')
                    if ':' in decoded:
                        user, pwd = decoded.split(':',1)
                        for ent in self.config["auth_entries"]:
                            if ent["username"]==user and check_auth_entry(ent, pwd):
                                authorized=True
                                break
                except:
                    pass
            if not authorized:
                self.send_response(401)
                self.send_header('WWW-Authenticate','Basic')
                self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(timeval=None, localtime=False, usegmt=True))
                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.end_headers()
                if self.config.get("verbose"):
                    now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                    sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {self.path} HTTP/1.1" 401 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\n')
                return

        # internal assets
        if effective_path.startswith("/__miniserve_internal/"):
            if effective_path == "/__miniserve_internal/favicon.svg":
                body = FAVICON_SVG.encode('utf-8')
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type','image/svg+xml')
                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.end_headers()
                if method!="HEAD":
                    self.wfile.write(body)
                return
            elif effective_path == "/__miniserve_internal/style.css":
                body = STYLE_CSS.encode('utf-8')
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type','text/css; charset=utf-8')
                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.end_headers()
                if method!="HEAD":
                    self.wfile.write(body)
                return
            elif effective_path == "/__miniserve_internal/api":
                if method=="POST":
                    clen = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length',0))
                    data = self.rfile.read(clen) if clen>0 else b''
                    try:
                        j = json.loads(data.decode())
                        dir_path_str = j.get("DirSize")
                        if dir_path_str and self.config.get("directory_size"):
                            fs_path = self.resolve_fs_path(dir_path_str)
                            sz = self.calc_dir_size(fs_path)
                            disp = self.config.get("size_display","human")
                            sz_str = format_size_human(sz, disp)
                            body = sz_str.encode()
                            self.send_response(200)
                            self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                            self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                            for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                                self.send_header(k, v)
                            self.end_headers()
                            if method!="HEAD":
                                self.wfile.write(body)
                            return
                        else:
                            if not self.config.get("directory_size"):
                                self.send_response(404)
                                self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
                                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                                    self.send_header(k, v)
                                self.end_headers()
                                return
                    except Exception as e:
                        pass
                    self.send_response(400)
                    self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
                else:
                    self.send_response(404)
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
            else:
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

        # upload handling
        if effective_path.startswith("/upload") and method=="POST":
            upload_path_param = query_flat.get("path","/")
            # check upload enabled
            if not self.config.get("upload_enabled"):
                self.send_response(403)
                self.send_header('Content-Length','9')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b'Forbidden')
                return
            # check allowed upload dir
            allowed = self.config.get("allowed_upload_dir")
            if allowed is not None:
                # allowed is path string like "/a" or "/upload"
                # check if upload_path_param is within allowed
                def norm(p):
                    return p if p.endswith('/') else p+'/'
                if upload_path_param != allowed and not norm(upload_path_param).startswith(norm(allowed)) and allowed != "/":
                    body = b"Upload not allowed to this directory"
                    self.send_response(403)
                    self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                    self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                    self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                    self.end_headers()
                    self.wfile.write(body)
                    return

            ctype = self.headers.get('Content-Type','')
            clen = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length',0))
            data = self.rfile.read(clen) if clen>0 else b''
            # Parse multipart
            if 'multipart/form-data' in ctype:
                # extract boundary
                m = re.search(r'boundary=([^;]+)', ctype)
                if not m:
                    self.send_response(400)
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
                boundary = m.group(1).strip('"')
                parts = self.parse_multipart(data, boundary)
                # For each part
                for part in parts:
                    disp = part['headers'].get('content-disposition','')
                    # extract name and filename
                    name_match = re.search(r'name="([^"]+)"', disp)
                    fname_match = re.search(r'filename="([^"]+)"', disp)
                    name = name_match.group(1) if name_match else None
                    fname = fname_match.group(1) if fname_match else None
                    if fname:
                        base_name = os.path.basename(fname)
                        if not base_name:
                            continue
                        # media type check
                        mt = self.config.get("media_type")
                        if mt:
                            if not self.check_media_type(base_name, mt):
                                self.send_response(400)
                                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(f"File type not allowed: {base_name}".encode())))
                                self.end_headers()
                                self.wfile.write(f"File type not allowed: {base_name}".encode())
                                return
                        target_dir = self.resolve_fs_path(upload_path_param)
                        if not target_dir.is_dir():
                            body = f"Invalid path\ncaused by: cannot upload file to {target_dir}, since it's not a directory".encode()
                            self.send_response(400)
                            self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                            self.end_headers()
                            self.wfile.write(body)
                            return
                        dest = target_dir / base_name
                        # on duplicate handling
                        on_dup = self.config.get("on_duplicate","error")
                        if on_dup == "error" and dest.exists():
                            body = f"File {base_name} already exists".encode()
                            self.send_response(400)
                            self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                            self.end_headers()
                            self.wfile.write(body)
                            return
                        elif on_dup == "rename" and dest.exists():
                            dest = self.generate_rename_path(target_dir, base_name)
                        # temp dir handling
                        temp_dir = self.config.get("temp_dir")
                        try:
                            if temp_dir:
                                temp_path = pathlib.Path(temp_dir) / f"miniserve_tmp_{time.time_ns()}"
                                temp_path.write_bytes(part['body'])
                                shutil.move(str(temp_path), str(dest))
                            else:
                                dest.write_bytes(part['body'])
                            # chmod
                            chmod_val = self.config.get("chmod")
                            if chmod_val:
                                try:
                                    mode = int(chmod_val, 8)
                                    os.chmod(dest, mode)
                                except:
                                    pass
                        except Exception as e:
                            self.send_response(500)
                            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(str(e).encode())))
                            self.end_headers()
                            self.wfile.write(str(e).encode())
                            return
                    else:
                        # maybe mkdir
                        if name == "mkdir":
                            if not self.config.get("mkdir"):
                                body = f"Insufficient permissions to create file in {self.resolve_fs_path(upload_path_param)}".encode()
                                self.send_response(403)
                                self.send_header('Content-Type','text/plain; charset=utf-8')
                                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                                self.end_headers()
                                self.wfile.write(body)
                                return
                            dir_name = part['body'].decode().strip()
                            if not dir_name or '/' in dir_name or '\\' in dir_name or '..' in dir_name:
                                self.send_response(400)
                                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(b"Invalid directory name")))
                                self.end_headers()
                                self.wfile.write(b"Invalid directory name")
                                return
                            target_dir = self.resolve_fs_path(upload_path_param)
                            new_dir = target_dir / dir_name
                            try:
                                new_dir.mkdir()
                            except Exception as e:
                                self.send_response(500)
                                self.end_headers()
                                self.wfile.write(str(e).encode())
                                return
                # redirect
                location = upload_path_param
                if not location.startswith('/'):
                    location = '/' + location
                rp = self.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                location = rp + location
                self.send_response(303)
                self.send_header('Location', location)
                self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.end_headers()
                return
            else:
                self.send_response(400)
                self.end_headers()
                return

        # rm handling
        if effective_path.startswith("/rm") and method=="POST":
            if not self.config.get("rm_enabled"):
                self.send_response(403)
                self.end_headers()
                return
            rm_path_param = query_flat.get("path","/")
            allowed_rm = self.config.get("allowed_rm_dir")
            if allowed_rm is not None:
                def norm(p):
                    return p if p.endswith('/') else p+'/'
                if rm_path_param != allowed_rm and not norm(rm_path_param).startswith(norm(allowed_rm)) and allowed_rm != "/":
                    self.send_response(403)
                    self.send_header('Content-Type','text/html')
                    body = self.build_403_html()
                    self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
                    self.end_headers()
                    self.wfile.write(body.encode())
                    return
            target_fs = self.resolve_fs_path(rm_path_param)
            if not target_fs.exists():
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            # Ensure inside serve_path
            try:
                target_fs.resolve().relative_to(self.config["serve_path"].resolve())
            except:
                # check if serve_path is file? then disallow?
                if not self.config["serve_path_is_file"]:
                    # if target is outside, forbid
                    # but for file serve root, still check? For simplicity, if not inside, forbid
                    # We will use commonpath
                    serve_parent = self.config["serve_path"].resolve()
                    if not str(target_fs.resolve()).startswith(str(serve_parent)):
                        self.send_response(403)
                        self.end_headers()
                        return
            try:
                if target_fs.is_dir():
                    shutil.rmtree(target_fs)
                else:
                    target_fs.unlink()
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_response(500)
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(str(e).encode())
                return
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header('Location','/')
            self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
            self.end_headers()
            return

        # Now serve path
        serve_path = self.config["serve_path"]
        serve_is_file = self.config["serve_path_is_file"]

        if serve_is_file:
            if effective_path == "/":
                self.serve_file(serve_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            else:
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

        fs_path = self.resolve_fs_path(effective_path)

        # No symlinks check
        if self.config.get("no_symlinks"):
            if fs_path.is_symlink():
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            # Also check if any component is symlink? For simplicity, if fs_path resolves outside serve_path due to symlink, block via canonical check
            try:
                # resolve parent
                real = fs_path.resolve()
                serve_real = serve_path.resolve()
                if not str(real).startswith(str(serve_real)):
                    self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            except:
                pass

        # Check that fs_path is inside serve_path
        try:
            # If file doesn't exist, use parent
            check_path = fs_path if fs_path.exists() else fs_path.parent
            if check_path:
                # Use absolute
                serve_real = serve_path.resolve()
                # For non-existing, resolve parent
                if fs_path.exists():
                    real = fs_path.resolve()
                else:
                    # resolve parent and join
                    parent_real = fs_path.parent.resolve() if fs_path.parent.exists() else serve_real
                    real = parent_real / fs_path.name
                if not str(real).startswith(str(serve_real)):
                    self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return

        if fs_path.is_file():
            self.serve_file(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        if fs_path.is_dir():
            # download handling
            dl = query_flat.get("download")
            if dl:
                if dl=="tar" and self.config.get("enable_tar"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, False, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="tar_gz" and self.config.get("enable_tar_gz"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, True, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="zip" and self.config.get("enable_zip"):
                    self.serve_zip(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return

            # index file
            idx_name = self.config.get("index")
            if idx_name:
                idx_path = fs_path / idx_name
                if idx_path.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(idx_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return

            if self.config.get("disable_indexing"):
                self.send_404_file_not_found(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

            if not effective_path.endswith('/'):
                # redirect
                new_path = effective_path + "/"
                if query_string:
                    new_path += "?" + query_string
                rp = self.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                location = rp + new_path
                self.send_response(301)
                self.send_header('Location', location)
                self.send_header('Content-Length','0')
                self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
                for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                    self.send_header(k, v)
                self.end_headers()
                return

            self.serve_directory(fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method)
            return

        # pretty urls
        if self.config.get("pretty_urls"):
            cand = pathlib.Path(str(fs_path) + ".html")
            if cand.is_file():
                self.serve_file(cand, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

        # SPA
        if self.config.get("spa"):
            idx_name = self.config.get("index")
            if idx_name:
                idx_path = serve_path / idx_name
                if idx_path.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(idx_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return

        self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)

    def resolve_fs_path(self, url_path):
        # url_path like "/a/b" -> join to serve_path
        trimmed = url_path.lstrip('/')
        # clean components
        parts = []
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp == '.':
                continue
            elif comp == '..':
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p = self.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p = p / part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        total = 0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            # handle hidden and symlinks
            # filter hidden
            if not self.config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
            if self.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                # filter symlinks
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files = [f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                try:
                    total += os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def generate_rename_path(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p = pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem = p.stem
        suffix = p.suffix
        counter = 1
        while True:
            new_name = f"{stem}-{counter}{suffix}"
            new_path = dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            counter+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext = pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        image_exts = [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico",".tiff",".avif"]
        audio_exts = [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a",".wma"]
        video_exts = [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".wmv",".flv",".webm",".m4v"]
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in image_exts
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in audio_exts
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in video_exts
        else:
            return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        b_sep = f"\r\n--{boundary}".encode()
        parts = []
        # find boundaries
        # For simplicity use regex split via bytes
        # We'll implement similar to earlier Rust but using python
        # Use manual scanning
        pos=0
        while True:
            # find marker
            idx = data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            # after marker, skip \r\n
            start = idx + len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==b'\r\n':
                start+=2
            # find header end \r\n\r\n
            h_end = data.find(b'\r\n\r\n', start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes = data[start:h_end]
            body_start = h_end+4
            # find next separator or end marker
            next_idx = data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker = f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx = data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            # Determine which comes first
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end = next_idx
                # Trim trailing \r\n if present
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==b'\r\n':
                    body_end-=2
                # parse headers
                header_str = header_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                hdrs = {}
                for line in header_str.split('\r\n'):
                    if ':' in line:
                        k,v = line.split(':',1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers": hdrs, "body": data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos = next_idx + len(b_sep)
                # after sep, there is \r\n then headers? Actually sep already includes \r\n, but our loop expects marker after. So adjust?
                # For next iteration, pos should be at next_idx
                # But we already skipped \r\n part of sep, so need to add 2? Let's see: sep = \r\n--boundary, so after finding sep, next data starts immediately after sep. So pos = next_idx
                # Actually next_idx points to \r\n--boundary, so after marker, we should continue from next_idx
                # But we already advanced pos to after sep? We'll set pos = next_idx
                pos = next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end = end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==b'\r\n':
                    body_end-=2
                header_str = header_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                hdrs = {}
                for line in header_str.split('\r\n'):
                    if ':' in line:
                        k,v = line.split(':',1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers": hdrs, "body": data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

    def serve_file(self, file_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        try:
            st = file_path.stat()
        except:
            self.send_404(str(file_path), raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        size = st.st_size
        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, localtime=False, usegmt=True)
        # ETag
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(file_path):x}"'
        # Check If-None-Match
        if_none = self.headers.get('If-None-Match')
        if if_none and (if_none.strip() == etag or if_none.strip() == etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header('Content-Disposition', f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')
            self.send_header('Accept-Ranges','bytes')
            self.send_header('Last-Modified', last_mod)
            self.send_header('ETag', etag)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k, v)
            self.end_headers()
            return

        # Range
        range_header = self.headers.get('Range')
        start = 0
        end = size-1
        partial = False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith('bytes='):
            spec = range_header[6:]
            if '-' in spec:
                s,e = spec.split('-',1)
                try:
                    if s=='' and e!='':
                        # suffix
                        suffix = int(e)
                        if suffix <= size:
                            start = size - suffix
                            end = size-1
                            partial = True
                    elif s!='' and e=='':
                        start = int(s)
                        end = size-1
                        partial = True
                    elif s!='' and e!='':
                        start = int(s)
                        end = int(e)
                        if start < size:
                            if end >= size:
                                end = size-1
                            partial = True
                except:
                    pass

        content_length = end - start + 1 if partial else size

        # Read file
        try:
            f = open(file_path,'rb')
            if partial:
                f.seek(start)
                data = f.read(content_length)
            else:
                if method!="HEAD":
                    data = f.read()
                else:
                    data = b''
            f.close()
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return

        mime = get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp_type = "attachment" if file_path.name.startswith('.') or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime=="application/octet-stream" and file_path.suffix=='':
            disp_type="attachment"
        # For text etc inline
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp_type="inline"

        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(content_length))
        self.send_header('Content-Type', mime)
        self.send_header('Content-Disposition', f'{disp_type}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header('Accept-Ranges','bytes')
        self.send_header('Last-Modified', last_mod)
        self.send_header('ETag', etag)
        self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header('Content-Range', f'bytes {start}-{end}/{size}')
        for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            # If header already set, don't overwrite
            if k.lower() not in [h.lower() for h in [x[0] for x in self._headers_buffer]]:
                self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)

        if self.config.get("verbose"):
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {content_length} "-" "-" 0.000000\n')

    def serve_directory(self, fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method):
        # sorting
        sort_method = query_flat.get("sort", self.config.get("default_sorting_method","name"))
        sort_order = query_flat.get("order", self.config.get("default_sorting_order","desc"))
        if sort_method not in ["name","size","date"]:
            sort_method = self.config.get("default_sorting_method","name")
        if sort_order not in ["asc","desc"]:
            sort_order = self.config.get("default_sorting_order","desc")

        # list entries
        entries = []
        try:
            for entry in os.scandir(fs_path):
                name = entry.name
                if not self.config.get("hidden") and name.startswith('.'):
                    continue
                is_symlink = entry.is_symlink()
                if self.config.get("no_symlinks") and is_symlink:
                    continue
                try:
                    is_dir = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks= True if not self.config.get("no_symlinks") else False)
                except:
                    is_dir = entry.is_dir()
                # For symlink, get target?
                symlink_target = None
                if is_symlink and self.config.get("show_symlink_info"):
                    try:
                        symlink_target = os.readlink(entry.path)
                    except:
                        pass
                try:
                    st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=True)
                    sz = 0 if is_dir else st.st_size
                    mtime = st.st_mtime
                except:
                    sz = 0
                    mtime = time.time()
                entries.append({"name": name, "is_dir": is_dir, "is_symlink": is_symlink, "symlink_target": symlink_target, "size": sz, "mtime": mtime})
        except:
            self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return

        # sort
        def sort_key(e):
            if sort_method=="name":
                return e["name"].lower()
            elif sort_method=="size":
                return e["size"]
            else:
                return e["mtime"]
        reverse = (sort_order=="desc")
        if self.config.get("dirs_first"):
            entries.sort(key=lambda e: (not e["is_dir"], sort_key(e)), reverse=reverse)
            # dirs_first with reverse needs special handling: we want dirs first regardless of order? Original dirs-first lists directories first, then sorts within groups by method/order.
            # So we should sort with dirs_first separately
            # We'll do stable sort: first sort by method, then put dirs first
            entries.sort(key=sort_key, reverse=reverse)
            # Now stable partition: dirs first
            dirs = [e for e in entries if e["is_dir"]]
            files = [e for e in entries if not e["is_dir"]]
            entries = dirs + files
        else:
            entries.sort(key=sort_key, reverse=reverse)

            for e in entries:

                    if effective_path=="/":

            body = html_out.encode('utf-8')

    def serve_tar(self, dir_path, gz, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        # create tar in memory
        bio = io.BytesIO()
        mode = 'w:gz' if gz else 'w'
        try:
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=bio, mode=mode) as tar:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                    if not self.config.get("hidden"):
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                        files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
                    if self.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                        files = [f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
                    for f in files:
                        full = os.path.join(root, f)
                        arcname = os.path.relpath(full, dir_path)
                        tar.add(full, arcname=arcname)
            data = bio.getvalue()
        except Exception as e:
            data = b''
        filename = dir_path.name + (".tar.gz" if gz else ".tar")
        ctype = "application/gzip" if gz else "application/x-tar"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.send_header('Content-Disposition', f'attachment; filename="{filename}"')
        self.send_header('Content-Transfer-Encoding','binary')
        self.send_header('Date', email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        for k,v in self.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def serve_zip(self, dir_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        bio = io.BytesIO()

            with zipfile.ZipFile(bio, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as zf:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                    if not self.config.get("hidden"):
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
                        files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith('.')]
                    if self.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                        files = [f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
                    for f in files:
                        full = os.path.join(root, f)
                        arcname = os.path.relpath(full, dir_path)
                        zf.write(full, arcname)
            data = bio.getvalue()
        except Exception as e:

def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    args = parse_args(argv)

    if args.get("help"):
        print(HELP_TEXT)

        print(SHORT_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

        print(f"miniserve {VERSION}")
        sys.exit(0)

        print_manpage()
        sys.exit(0)

    # TLS validation
    tls_cert = args.get("tls_cert")
    tls_key = args.get("tls_key")
    if tls_cert and not tls_key:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --tls-key <TLS_KEY>\n\nUsage: miniserve --tls-cert <TLS_CERT> --tls-key <TLS_KEY> <PATH>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if tls_key and not tls_cert:
        sys.stderr.write("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  --tls-cert <TLS_CERT>\n\nUsage: miniserve --tls-cert <TLS_CERT> --tls-key <TLS_KEY> <PATH>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        sys.exit(2)
    if tls_cert and tls_key:
        # For simplicity, we don't support TLS in this minimal impl, but we will pretend to support by starting still HTTP? Original would start TLS.
        # To avoid breaking, we will print warning and continue as HTTP.
        pass

    # Serve path
    serve_path_str = args.get("path")
    if serve_path_str:
        sp = pathlib.Path(serve_path_str)
        if not sp.exists():
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f"{now} [ERROR] Failed to resolve path to be served\n")
            sys.stderr.write(f"{now} [ERROR] caused by: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
            sys.stderr.write("Error: Failed to resolve path to be served\ncaused by: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        serve_path = sp.resolve()
    else:
        # check terminal
        if not sys.stdin.isatty():
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f"{now} [ERROR] Refusing to start as no explicit serve path was set and no interactive terminal was attached\n")

            auth_entries.append(ent)
    auth_file = args.get("auth_file")
    if auth_file:
        try:
            content = pathlib.Path(auth_file).read_text()
            for line in content.splitlines():
                line=line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                ent = parse_auth_str(line)

# miniserve - serve files and directories over HTTP

miniserve is a small command-line tool that serves files and directories over HTTP. It is intended for
quick ad-hoc sharing of files from a machine on a network.

Usage examples

Serve a directory:

    miniserve /path/to/directory

Serve a single file:

    miniserve /path/to/file.iso

Set a custom index file:

    miniserve --index index.html /path/to/directory

Serve a Single Page Application (forward non-existent paths to the SPA index):

    miniserve --spa --index index.html /path/to/spa

Require username/password:

    miniserve --auth user:password /path/to/directory

Start with TLS:

    miniserve --tls-cert /path/to/cert.pem --tls-key /path/to/key.pem /path/to/directory

Upload a file using curl (when upload support is enabled):

    # in one terminal
    miniserve -u -- .
    # in another terminal
    curl -F "path=@$FILE" http://localhost:8080/upload\?path\=/

For a full list of available options and flags, consult the tool's built-in help:

    miniserve --help

def get_mime_type(path):
    ext = pathlib.Path(path).suffix.lower()
    mime_map = {
        ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
        ".htm": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
        ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
        ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
        ".json": "application/json",
        ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
        ".md": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
        ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
        ".png": "image/png",
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
        ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
        ".gif": "image/gif",
        ".webp": "image/webp",
        ".ico": "image/x-icon",
        ".mp3": "audio/mpeg",
        ".wav": "audio/wav",
        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
        ".pdf": "application/pdf",
        ".zip": "application/zip",
        ".tar": "application/x-tar",
        ".gz": "application/gzip",
        ".tgz": "application/gzip",
    }
    return mime_map.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):
    return html.escape(s)

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"]==pw
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):
    return html.escape(s)

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"]==pw
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

            self.end_headers()
            return

        serve_path = self.server.config["serve_path"]
        serve_is_file = self.server.config["serve_path_is_file"]
        if serve_is_file:
            if effective_path == "/":
                self.serve_file(serve_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            else:
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

        fs_path = self.resolve_fs(effective_path)

        # symlink and traversal checks
        if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
            if fs_path.is_symlink():
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        # check inside serve_path
        try:
            serve_real = serve_path.resolve()
            if fs_path.exists():
                real = fs_path.resolve()
            else:
                # parent
                if fs_path.parent.exists():
                    real = fs_path.parent.resolve() / fs_path.name
                else:
                    real = fs_path
            if not str(real).startswith(str(serve_real)):
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        except:
            pass

        if fs_path.is_file():
            self.serve_file(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        if fs_path.is_dir():
            dl = query_flat.get("download")
            if dl:
                if dl=="tar" and self.server.config.get("enable_tar"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, False, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="tar_gz" and self.server.config.get("enable_tar_gz"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, True, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="zip" and self.server.config.get("enable_zip"):
                    self.serve_zip(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            idx = self.server.config.get("index")
            if idx:
                ip = fs_path / idx
                if ip.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            if self.server.config.get("disable_indexing"):
                self.send_404_file_not_found(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            if not effective_path.endswith("/"):
                newp = effective_path + "/"
                if query_string:
                    newp += "?" + query_string
                rp = self.server.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                loc = rp + newp
                self.send_response(301)
                self.send_header("Location", loc)
                self.send_header("Content-Length","0")
                self.end_headers()
                return
            self.serve_directory(fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method)
            return

        if self.server.config.get("pretty_urls"):
            cand = pathlib.Path(str(fs_path) + ".html")
            if cand.is_file():
                self.serve_file(cand, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        if self.server.config.get("spa"):
            idx = self.server.config.get("index")
            if idx:
                ip = serve_path / idx
                if ip.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
        self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed = url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts = []
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp == ".":
                continue
            elif comp == "..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p = self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p = p / part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files = [f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp = os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p = pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem = p.stem
        suffix = p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name = f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path = dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext = pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        b_sep = f"\\r\\n--{boundary}".encode()
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx = data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start = idx + len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==b"\\r\\n":
                start+=2
            h_end = data.find(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes = data[start:h_end]
            body_start = h_end+4
            next_idx = data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker = f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx = data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end = next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str = header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str = header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

    def serve_file(self, file_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        try:
            st = file_path.stat()
        except:
            self.send_404(str(file_path), raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        size = st.st_size
        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, usegmt=True)
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(str(file_path)):x}"'
        if_none = self.headers.get("If-None-Match")
        if if_none and (if_none.strip()==etag or if_none.strip()==etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')
            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
            self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
            self.send_header("ETag", etag)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k,v)
            self.end_headers()
            if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
                now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "GET {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" 304 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\\n')
            return

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start=0
        end=size-1
        partial=False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            spec=range_header[6:]
            if "-" in spec:
                s,e=spec.split("-",1)
                try:
                    if s=="" and e!="":
                        suffix=int(e)
                        if suffix<=size:
                            start=size-suffix
                            end=size-1
                            partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e=="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=size-1
                        partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e!="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=int(e)
                        if start<size:
                            if end>=size:
                                end=size-1
                            partial=True
                except:
                    pass
        clen = end-start+1 if partial else size
        try:
            f=open(file_path,"rb")
            if partial:
                f.seek(start)
                data=f.read(clen)
            else:
                data=f.read() if method!="HEAD" else b""
            f.close()
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        mime=get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp="attachment" if file_path.name.startswith(".") or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp="inline"
        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(clen))
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'{disp}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
        self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
        self.send_header("ETag", etag)
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            # avoid duplicate
            if k.lower() not in ["content-length","content-type","content-disposition","accept-ranges","last-modified","etag","date","content-range","content-encoding"]:
                self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)
        if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {clen} "-" "-" 0.000000\\n')

    def serve_tar(self, dir_path, gz, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        bio=io.BytesIO()
        mode='w:gz' if gz else 'w'
        try:
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=bio, mode=mode) as tar:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                    if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                        files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
                    if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                        files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
                    for f in files:
                        full=os.path.join(root,f)
                        arc=os.path.relpath(full, dir_path)
                        tar.add(full, arcname=arc)
            data=bio.getvalue()
        except Exception as e:
            data=b""
        fname=dir_path.name + (".tar.gz" if gz else ".tar")
        ctype="application/gzip" if gz else "application/x-tar"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="{fname}"')
        self.send_header("Content-Transfer-Encoding","binary")
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed=url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts=[]
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp==".":
                continue
            elif comp=="..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p=self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p=p/part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        return MyHandler.calc_dir_size_static(path, self.server.config)

    @staticmethod
    def calc_dir_size_static(path, config):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp=os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p=pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem=p.stem
        suffix=p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name=f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path=dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext=pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        b_sep = f"\\r\\n--{boundary}".encode()
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx=data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start=idx+len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==b"\\r\\n":
                start+=2
            h_end=data.find(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes=data[start:h_end]
            body_start=h_end+4
            next_idx=data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker=f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx=data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end=next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts
