                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            if self.server.config.get("disable_indexing"):
                self.send_404_file_not_found(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            if not effective_path.endswith("/"):
                newp = effective_path + "/"
                if query_string:
                    newp += "?" + query_string
                rp = self.server.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                loc = rp + newp
                self.send_response(301)
                self.send_header("Location", loc)
                self.send_header("Content-Length","0")
                self.end_headers()
                return
            self.serve_directory(fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method)
            return

        if self.server.config.get("pretty_urls"):
            cand = pathlib.Path(str(fs_path) + ".html")
            if cand.is_file():
                self.serve_file(cand, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        if self.server.config.get("spa"):
            idx = self.server.config.get("index")
            if idx:
                ip = serve_path / idx
                if ip.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
        self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed = url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts = []
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp == ".":
                continue
            elif comp == "..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p = self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p = p / part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files = [f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files = [f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp = os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p = pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem = p.stem
        suffix = p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name = f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path = dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext = pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        b_sep = f"\\r\\n--{boundary}".encode()
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx = data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start = idx + len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==b"\\r\\n":
                start+=2
            h_end = data.find(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes = data[start:h_end]
            body_start = h_end+4
            next_idx = data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker = f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx = data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end = next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str = header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str = header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

    def serve_file(self, file_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        try:
            st = file_path.stat()
        except:
            self.send_404(str(file_path), raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        size = st.st_size
        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, usegmt=True)
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(str(file_path)):x}"'
        if_none = self.headers.get("If-None-Match")
        if if_none and (if_none.strip()==etag or if_none.strip()==etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')
            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
            self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
            self.send_header("ETag", etag)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k,v)
            self.end_headers()
            if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
                now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "GET {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" 304 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\\n')
            return

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start=0
        end=size-1
        partial=False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            spec=range_header[6:]
            if "-" in spec:
                s,e=spec.split("-",1)
                try:
                    if s=="" and e!="":
                        suffix=int(e)
                        if suffix<=size:
                            start=size-suffix
                            end=size-1
                            partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e=="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=size-1
                        partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e!="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=int(e)
                        if start<size:
                            if end>=size:
                                end=size-1
                            partial=True
                except:
                    pass
        clen = end-start+1 if partial else size
        try:
            f=open(file_path,"rb")
            if partial:
                f.seek(start)
                data=f.read(clen)
            else:
                data=f.read() if method!="HEAD" else b""
            f.close()
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        mime=get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp="attachment" if file_path.name.startswith(".") or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp="inline"
        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(clen))
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'{disp}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
        self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
        self.send_header("ETag", etag)
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            # avoid duplicate
            if k.lower() not in ["content-length","content-type","content-disposition","accept-ranges","last-modified","etag","date","content-range","content-encoding"]:
                self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)
        if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
            now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {clen} "-" "-" 0.000000\\n')

    def serve_tar(self, dir_path, gz, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        bio=io.BytesIO()
        mode='w:gz' if gz else 'w'
        try:
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=bio, mode=mode) as tar:
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dir_path):
                    if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                        files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
                    if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                        files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
                    for f in files:
                        full=os.path.join(root,f)
                        arc=os.path.relpath(full, dir_path)
                        tar.add(full, arcname=arc)
            data=bio.getvalue()
        except Exception as e:
            data=b""
        fname=dir_path.name + (".tar.gz" if gz else ".tar")
        ctype="application/gzip" if gz else "application/x-tar"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="{fname}"')
        self.send_header("Content-Transfer-Encoding","binary")
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed=url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts=[]
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp==".":
                continue
            elif comp=="..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p=self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p=p/part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        return MyHandler.calc_dir_size_static(path, self.server.config)

    @staticmethod
    def calc_dir_size_static(path, config):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp=os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p=pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem=p.stem
        suffix=p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name=f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path=dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext=pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        b_sep = f"\\r\\n--{boundary}".encode()
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx=data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start=idx+len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==b"\\r\\n":
                start+=2
            h_end=data.find(b"\\r\\n\\r\\n", start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes=data[start:h_end]
            body_start=h_end+4
            next_idx=data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker=f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx=data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end=next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==b"\\r\\n":
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):
    return html.escape(s)

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"]==pw
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):
    return html.escape(s)

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def format_size(size, display):

        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"]==pw
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

def format_size(size, display):

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:

def render_md(md):
    out=""

    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:

    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):
    if entry["type"] is None:
        return entry["hash"]==pw
    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":
        return hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()
    else:
        return False

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

def parse_auth_str(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    parts=s.split(':')
    if len(parts)==1:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":""}
    elif len(parts)==2:
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":parts[1]}
    elif len(parts)==3:
        if parts[1] not in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return None
        return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":parts[2]}
    else:
        if parts[1] in ("sha256","sha512"):
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":parts[1],"hash":':'.join(parts[2:])}
        else:
            return {"username":parts[0],"type":None,"hash":':'.join(parts[1:])}

def check_auth_entry(entry, pw):

    elif entry["type"]=="sha256":

    elif entry["type"]=="sha512":
        return hashlib.sha512(pw.encode()).hexdigest()==entry["hash"].lower()

def format_size(size, display):
    if display == "exact":
        return f"{size} B"
    else:
        if size < 1024:
            return f"{size} B"
        elif size < 1024*1024:
            return f"{size/1024:.1f} KiB"
        elif size < 1024*1024*1024:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024):.1f} MiB"
        else:
            return f"{size/(1024*1024*1024):.1f} GiB"

def relative_time(mtime):
    now = time.time()
    diff = now - mtime
    if diff < 10:
        return "now"
    elif diff < 60:
        return f"{int(diff)} seconds ago"
    elif diff < 120:
        return "a minute ago"
    elif diff < 3600:
        return f"{int(diff//60)} minutes ago"
    elif diff < 7200:
        return "an hour ago"
    elif diff < 86400:
        return f"{int(diff//3600)} hours ago"
    elif diff < 172800:
        return "a day ago"
    else:
        return f"{int(diff//86400)} days ago"

def escape_html(s):

def render_md(md):
    out=""
    in_p=False
    for line in md.splitlines():
        t=line.strip()
        if not t:
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            continue
        if t.startswith("# "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h1>{escape_html(t[2:].strip())}</h1>"
        elif t.startswith("## "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h2>{escape_html(t[3:].strip())}</h2>"
        elif t.startswith("### "):
            if in_p:
                out+="</p>"
                in_p=False
            out+=f"<h3>{escape_html(t[4:].strip())}</h3>"
        else:
            if not in_p:
                out+="<p>"
                in_p=True
            else:
                out+=" "
            out+=escape_html(t)
    if in_p:
        out+="</p>"
    if not out:
        out=f"<p>{escape_html(md)}</p>"
    return out

def generate_qr(url):
    modules=[[False]*27 for _ in range(27)]
    for fx,fy in [(0,0),(0,20),(20,0)]:
        for y in range(7):
            for x in range(7):
                if x==0 or x==6 or y==0 or y==6 or (2<=x<=4 and 2<=y<=4):
                    modules[fy+y][fx+x]=True
    h=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).digest()
    bits=[]
    for b in h:
        for i in range(8):
            bits.append((b>>i)&1==1)
    idx=0
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if (x<8 and y<8) or (x>=19 and y<8) or (x<8 and y>=19):
                continue
            if x==6 or y==6:
                continue
            if bits[idx % len(bits)]:
                modules[y][x]=True
            idx+=1
    d=""
    for y in range(27):
        for x in range(27):
            if modules[y][x]:
                d+=f"M{x},{y}h1v1h-1"
    return f'<svg viewBox="0 0 27 27" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="27px" height="27px" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="{d}"/></svg>'

                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\r\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==crlf:
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\r\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

    def serve_file(self, file_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        try:
            st = file_path.stat()
        except:
            self.send_404(str(file_path), raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        size = st.st_size
        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, usegmt=True)
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(str(file_path)) & 0xFFFFFFFF:x}"'
        if_none = self.headers.get("If-None-Match")
        if if_none and (if_none.strip()==etag or if_none.strip()==etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')
            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
            self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
            self.send_header("ETag", etag)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k,v)
            self.end_headers()
            if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
                now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "GET {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" 304 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\n')
            return

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start=0
        end=size-1
        partial=False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            spec=range_header[6:]
            if "-" in spec:
                s,e=spec.split("-",1)
                try:
                    if s=="" and e!="":
                        suffix=int(e)
                        if suffix<=size:
                            start=size-suffix
                            end=size-1
                            partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e=="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=size-1
                        partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e!="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=int(e)
                        if start<size:
                            if end>=size:
                                end=size-1
                            partial=True
                except:
                    pass
        clen = end-start+1 if partial else size
        try:
            f=open(file_path,"rb")
            if partial:
                f.seek(start)
                data=f.read(clen)
            else:
                data=f.read() if method!="HEAD" else b""
            f.close()
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        mime=get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp="attachment" if file_path.name.startswith(".") or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp="inline"
        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(clen))
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'{disp}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
        self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
        self.send_header("ETag", etag)
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            if k.lower() not in ["content-length","content-type","content-disposition","accept-ranges","last-modified","etag","date","content-range","content-encoding"]:
                self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)
        if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
            now=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {clen} "-" "-" 0.000000\n')

    def serve_directory(self, fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method):

        for entry in os.scandir(fs_path):
            name=entry.name
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden") and name.startswith("."):
                continue
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks") and entry.is_symlink():
                continue
            is_dir = entry.is_dir()
            is_symlink = entry.is_symlink()
            symlink_target = None
            if is_symlink and self.server.config.get("show_symlink_info"):
                try:
                    symlink_target=os.readlink(entry.path)
                except:
                    pass
            try:
                st=entry.stat(follow_symlinks=True)
                sz=0 if is_dir else st.st_size
                mt=st.st_mtime
            except:
                sz=0
                mt=time.time()
            entries.append({"name":name,"is_dir":is_dir,"is_symlink":is_symlink,"symlink_target":symlink_target,"size":sz,"mtime":mt})

        def keyfunc(e):

                                self.wfile.write(b"Invalid directory name")
                                return
                            target_dir = self.resolve_fs(up_param)
                            new_dir = target_dir / dname
                            try:
                                new_dir.mkdir()
                            except Exception as e:
                                self.send_response(500)
                                self.end_headers()
                                self.wfile.write(str(e).encode())
                                return
                loc = up_param
                if not loc.startswith("/"):
                    loc = "/" + loc
                rp = self.server.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                loc = rp + loc
                self.send_response(303)
                self.send_header("Location", loc)
                self.send_header("Content-Length","0")
                self.end_headers()
                return
            else:
                self.send_response(400)
                self.end_headers()
                return

        if effective_path.startswith("/rm") and method=="POST":
            if not self.server.config.get("rm_enabled"):
                self.send_response(403)
                self.end_headers()
                return
            rm_param = query_flat.get("path","/")
            allowed_rm = self.server.config.get("allowed_rm_dir")
            if allowed_rm is not None:
                def norm(p):
                    return p if p.endswith("/") else p+"/"
                if rm_param != allowed_rm and not norm(rm_param).startswith(norm(allowed_rm)) and allowed_rm != "/":
                    self.send_response(403)
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
            target = self.resolve_fs(rm_param)
            if not target.exists():
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            serve_real = self.server.config["serve_path"].resolve()
            try:
                if not str(target.resolve()).startswith(str(serve_real)):
                    self.send_response(403)
                    self.end_headers()
                    return
            except:
                pass
            try:
                if target.is_dir():
                    shutil.rmtree(target)
                else:
                    target.unlink()
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_response(500)
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(str(e).encode())
                return
            self.send_response(303)
            self.send_header("Location","/")
            self.send_header("Content-Length","0")
            self.end_headers()
            return

        serve_path = self.server.config["serve_path"]
        serve_is_file = self.server.config["serve_path_is_file"]
        if serve_is_file:
            if effective_path == "/":
                self.serve_file(serve_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            else:
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return

        fs_path = self.resolve_fs(effective_path)

        if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
            if fs_path.is_symlink():
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        try:
            serve_real = serve_path.resolve()
            if fs_path.exists():
                real = fs_path.resolve()
            else:
                if fs_path.parent.exists():
                    real = fs_path.parent.resolve() / fs_path.name
                else:
                    real = fs_path
            if not str(real).startswith(str(serve_real)):
                self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        except:
            pass

        if fs_path.is_file():
            self.serve_file(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        if fs_path.is_dir():
            dl = query_flat.get("download")
            if dl:
                if dl=="tar" and self.server.config.get("enable_tar"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, False, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="tar_gz" and self.server.config.get("enable_tar_gz"):
                    self.serve_tar(fs_path, True, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
                if dl=="zip" and self.server.config.get("enable_zip"):
                    self.serve_zip(fs_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            idx = self.server.config.get("index")
            if idx:
                ip = fs_path / idx
                if ip.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
            if self.server.config.get("disable_indexing"):
                self.send_404_file_not_found(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
            if not effective_path.endswith("/"):
                newp = effective_path + "/"
                if query_string:
                    newp += "?" + query_string
                rp = self.server.config.get("route_prefix") or ""
                loc = rp + newp
                self.send_response(301)
                self.send_header("Location", loc)
                self.send_header("Content-Length","0")
                self.end_headers()
                return
            self.serve_directory(fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method)
            return

        if self.server.config.get("pretty_urls"):
            cand = pathlib.Path(str(fs_path) + ".html")
            if cand.is_file():
                self.serve_file(cand, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                return
        if self.server.config.get("spa"):
            idx = self.server.config.get("index")
            if idx:
                ip = serve_path / idx
                if ip.is_file():
                    self.serve_file(ip, method, raw_path_full, query_flat)
                    return
        self.send_404(effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat)

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed=url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts=[]
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp==".":
                continue
            elif comp=="..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p=self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p=p/part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp=os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p=pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem=p.stem
        suffix=p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name=f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path=dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext=pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = f"--{boundary}".encode()
        # use byte patterns with real CRLF via bytes building to avoid escaping issues
        crlf = b"\r\n"
        crlf2 = b"\r\n\r\n"
        b_sep = crlf + b_marker
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx=data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start=idx+len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==crlf:
                start+=2
            h_end=data.find(crlf2, start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes=data[start:h_end]
            body_start=h_end+4
            next_idx=data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker=f"--{boundary}--".encode()
            end_idx=data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end=next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==crlf:
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\r\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==crlf:
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\r\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

    def serve_file(self, file_path, method, raw_path_full, query_flat):
        try:
            st = file_path.stat()
        except:
            self.send_404(str(file_path), raw_path_full, query_flat)
            return
        size = st.st_size
        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, usegmt=True)
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(str(file_path)) & 0xFFFFFFFF:x}"'
        if_none = self.headers.get("If-None-Match")
        if if_none and (if_none.strip()==etag or if_none.strip()==etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')
            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
            self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
            self.send_header("ETag", etag)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k,v)
            self.end_headers()
            if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
                now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "GET {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" 304 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\n')
            return

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start=0
        end=size-1
        partial=False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            spec=range_header[6:]
            if "-" in spec:
                s,e=spec.split("-",1)
                try:
                    if s=="" and e!="":
                        suffix=int(e)
                        if suffix<=size:
                            start=size-suffix
                            end=size-1
                            partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e=="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=size-1
                        partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e!="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=int(e)
                        if start<size:
                            if end>=size:
                                end=size-1
                            partial=True
                except:
                    pass
        clen = end-start+1 if partial else size
        try:
            f=open(file_path,"rb")
            if partial:
                f.seek(start)
                data=f.read(clen)
            else:
                data=f.read() if method!="HEAD" else b""
            f.close()
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        mime=get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp="attachment" if file_path.name.startswith(".") or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp="inline"
        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(clen))
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'{disp}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
        self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
        self.send_header("ETag", etag)
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            if k.lower() not in ["content-length","content-type","content-disposition","accept-ranges","last-modified","etag","date","content-range","content-encoding"]:
                self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)
        if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
            now=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {clen} "-" "-" 0.000000\n')

    def serve_directory(self, fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method):
        sort_method = query_flat.get("sort", self.server.config.get("default_sorting_method","name"))
        sort_order = query_flat.get("order", self.server.config.get("default_sorting_order","desc"))
        entries=[]
        for entry in os.scandir(fs_path):
            name=entry.name
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden") and name.startswith("."):
                continue
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks") and entry.is_symlink():
                continue
            is_dir = entry.is_dir()
            is_symlink = entry.is_symlink()
            symlink_target = None
            if is_symlink and self.server.config.get("show_symlink_info"):
                try:
                    symlink_target=os.readlink(entry.path)
                except:
                    pass
            try:
                st=entry.stat(follow_symlinks=True)
                sz=0 if is_dir else st.st_size
                mt=st.st_mtime
            except:
                sz=0
                mt=time.time()
            entries.append({"name":name,"is_dir":is_dir,"is_symlink":is_symlink,"symlink_target":symlink_target,"size":sz,"mtime":mt})

        def keyfunc(e):
            if sort_method=="size":
                return e["size"]
            elif sort_method=="date":
                return e["mtime"]
            else:
                return e["name"].lower()
        reverse = (sort_order=="desc")
        if self.server.config.get("dirs_first"):
            entries.sort(key=keyfunc, reverse=reverse)
            dirs=[e for e in entries if e["is_dir"]]
            files=[e for e in entries if not e["is_dir"]]
            entries=dirs+files
        else:
            entries.sort(key=keyfunc, reverse=reverse)

        is_raw = query_flat.get("raw")=="true"
        if is_raw:
            html_out='<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><table><thead><th class="name">Name</th><th class="size">Size</th><th class="date">Last modification</th></thead><tbody>'
            if effective_path!="/":
                trimmed=effective_path.rstrip("/")
                parent="/".join(trimmed.split("/")[:-1])
                if parent=="":
                    parent="/"
                else:
                    if not parent.startswith("/"):
                        parent="/"+parent
                    if not parent.endswith("/"):
                        parent+="/"
                html_out+=f'<tr><td colspan="3"><p><a class="root" href="{parent}?raw=true">..</a></p></td></tr>'
            for e in entries:
                if e["is_dir"]:
                    href=f"/{e['name']}/?raw=true" if effective_path=="/" else f"{effective_path}{e['name']}/?raw=true"
                    html_out+=f'<tr class="entry-type-directory"><td><p><a class="directory" href="{href}">{e["name"]}/</a></p></td><td class="size-cell"></td><td class="date-cell"><span>{datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(e["mtime"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")} </span><span class="history">{relative_time(e["mtime"])}</span></td></tr>'
                else:
                    href=f"/{e['name']}" if effective_path=="/" else f"{effective_path}{e['name']}"
                    ext=self.server.config.get("file_external_url")
                    if ext:
                        href=ext.rstrip("/")+href
                    html_out+=f'<tr class="entry-type-file"><td><p><a class="file" href="{href}">{e["name"]}</a></p></td><td class="size-cell">{format_size(e["size"], self.server.config.get("size_display","human"))}</td><td class="date-cell"><span>{datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(e["mtime"]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")} </span><span class="history">{relative_time(e["mtime"])}</span></td></tr>'
            html_out+='</tbody></table></body></html>'
            body=html_out.encode()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","text/html; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            if method!="HEAD":
                self.wfile.write(body)
            return

        host_display = self.server.config.get("title") or self.headers.get("Host") or f"127.0.0.1:{self.server.config.get('port',8080)}"
        rp = self.server.config.get("route_prefix") or ""

            for i,part in enumerate(parts):

                href=rp+up
                if is_last:
                    breadcrumb+=f'<span><bdi>{escape_html(part)}</bdi></span>/'

        toolbar_download=""

        upload_enabled=self.server.config.get("upload_enabled")
        mkdir_enabled=self.server.config.get("mkdir")
        toolbar_box=""
        if upload_enabled or mkdir_enabled:
            toolbar_box='<div class="toolbar_box_group">'

                up_path=effective_path
                action=f"{rp}/upload?path={up_path}"

            if mkdir_enabled:
                up_path=effective_path
                action=f"{rp}/upload?path={up_path}"

            toolbar_box+='</div>'
        else:
            toolbar_box='<div class="toolbar_box_group"></div>'

        rows=""

            trimmed=effective_path.rstrip("/")

            if parent=="":
                parent="/"
            else:
                if not parent.startswith("/"):
                    parent="/"+parent
                if not parent.endswith("/"):
                    parent+="/"
            parent_href=rp+parent
            sq=""
            if "sort" in query_flat or "order" in query_flat:
                parts=[]
                if "sort" in query_flat:
                    parts.append(f"sort={query_flat['sort']}")
                if "order" in query_flat:
                    parts.append(f"order={query_flat['order']}")

                parent_href+=sq
            rows+=f'<tr><td colspan="3"><p><span class="root-chevron">◂</span><a class="root" href="{parent_href}">Parent directory</a></p></td></tr>'

        for e in entries:
            if e["is_dir"]:
                href=f"/{e['name']}/" if effective_path=="/" else f"{effective_path}{e['name']}/"
            else:
                href=f"/{e['name']}" if effective_path=="/" else f"{effective_path}{e['name']}"
                ext=self.server.config.get("file_external_url")
                if ext and not e["is_dir"]:
                    href=ext.rstrip("/")+href
            if rp and not (self.server.config.get("file_external_url") and not e["is_dir"]):
                href=rp+href
            if e["is_dir"]:
                if "sort" in query_flat or "order" in query_flat:

            size_disp="" if e["is_dir"] else format_size(e["size"], self.server.config.get("size_display","human"))
            mtime_str=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(e["mtime"]).astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %:z")
            rel=relative_time(e["mtime"])

            if e["is_symlink"] and self.server.config.get("show_symlink_info"):
                tgt=e["symlink_target"] or ""
                rows+=f'<tr class="entry-type-file"><td><p><a class="symlink" href="{href}">{escape_html(e["name"])}<span class="symlink-symbol"></span><a class="file">{escape_html(tgt)}</a></a><span class="mobile-info size"><span class=""><span class="chevron">▾</span><a href="?sort=size&order=asc" title="Sort by size in ascending order">{size_disp} </a></span></span><span class="mobile-info history"><span class=""><span class="chevron">▾</span><a href="?sort=date&order=asc" title="Sort by date in ascending order">{rel}</a></span></span></p></td><td class="size-cell">{size_disp}</td><td class="date-cell"><span>{mtime_str} </span><span class="history">{rel}</span></td>'

                else:
                    rows+=f'<tr class="entry-type-file"><td><p><a class="file" href="{href}">{escape_html(e["name"])}</a><span class="mobile-info size"><span class=""><span class="chevron">▾</span><a href="?sort=size&order=asc" title="Sort by size in ascending order">{size_disp} </a></span></span><span class="mobile-info history"><span class=""><span class="chevron">▾</span><a href="?sort=date&order=asc" title="Sort by date in ascending order">{rel}</a></span></span></p></td><td class="size-cell">{size_disp}</td><td class="date-cell"><span>{mtime_str} </span><span class="history">{rel}</span></td>'

            if self.server.config.get("rm_enabled"):
                rm_path=f"/{e['name']}" if effective_path=="/" else f"{effective_path}{e['name']}"
                rm_action=f"{rp}/rm?path={rm_path}"
                rows+=f'<td class="actions-cell"><form class="rm_form" action="{rm_action}" method="POST"><button type="submit" title="Delete">✗</button></form></td>'
            rows+='</tr>'

        wget_footer=""
        if self.server.config.get("show_wget_footer"):
            host=self.headers.get("Host") or f"127.0.0.1:{self.server.config.get('port',8080)}"

    def resolve_fs(self, url_path):
        trimmed=url_path.lstrip("/")
        parts=[]
        for comp in pathlib.PurePosixPath(trimmed).parts:
            if comp==".":
                continue
            elif comp=="..":
                if parts:
                    parts.pop()
            else:
                parts.append(comp)
        p=self.server.config["serve_path"]
        for part in parts:
            p=p/part
        return p

    def calc_dir_size(self, path):
        total=0
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
                files=[f for f in files if not f.startswith(".")]
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks"):
                dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,d))]
                files=[f for f in files if not os.path.islink(os.path.join(root,f))]
            for f in files:
                fp=os.path.join(root,f)
                try:
                    total+=os.path.getsize(fp)
                except:
                    pass
        return total

    def gen_rename(self, dir_path, original_name):
        p=pathlib.Path(original_name)
        stem=p.stem
        suffix=p.suffix
        c=1
        while True:
            new_name=f"{stem}-{c}{suffix}"
            new_path=dir_path / new_name
            if not new_path.exists():
                return new_path
            c+=1

    def check_media_type(self, filename, mt):
        ext=pathlib.Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if mt=="image":
            return ext in [".jpg",".jpeg",".png",".gif",".bmp",".webp",".svg",".ico"]
        elif mt=="audio":
            return ext in [".mp3",".wav",".ogg",".flac",".aac",".m4a"]
        elif mt=="video":
            return ext in [".mp4",".avi",".mkv",".mov",".webm",".m4v"]
        return True

    def parse_multipart(self, data, boundary):
        b_marker = ("--" + boundary).encode()
        crlf = b"\r\n"
        crlf2 = b"\r\n\r\n"
        b_sep = crlf + b_marker
        parts=[]
        pos=0
        while pos < len(data):
            idx=data.find(b_marker, pos)
            if idx==-1:
                break
            start=idx+len(b_marker)
            if data[start:start+2]==crlf:
                start+=2
            h_end=data.find(crlf2, start)
            if h_end==-1:
                break
            header_bytes=data[start:h_end]
            body_start=h_end+4
            next_idx=data.find(b_sep, body_start)
            end_marker=("--" + boundary + "--").encode()
            end_idx=data.find(end_marker, body_start)
            if next_idx!=-1 and (end_idx==-1 or next_idx < end_idx):
                body_end=next_idx
                if data[body_end-2:body_end]==crlf:
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                pos=next_idx
                continue
            elif end_idx!=-1:
                body_end=end_idx
                if body_end>=2 and data[body_end-2:body_end]==crlf:
                    body_end-=2
                h_str=header_bytes.decode(errors="ignore")
                hdrs={}
                for line in h_str.split("\\r\\n"):
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        hdrs[k.strip().lower()]=v.strip()
                parts.append({"headers":hdrs,"body":data[body_start:body_end]})
                break
            else:
                break
        return parts

        except:

        mtime = st.st_mtime
        last_mod = email.utils.formatdate(mtime, usegmt=True)
        etag = f'"{int(mtime):x}:{size:x}:{hash(str(file_path)) & 0xFFFFFFFF:x}"'
        if_none = self.headers.get("If-None-Match")
        if if_none and (if_none.strip()==etag or if_none.strip()==etag.strip('"')):
            self.send_response(304)
            self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'inline; filename="{file_path.name}"')

            self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
            self.send_header("ETag", etag)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", get_mime_type(str(file_path)))
            self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
            for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
                self.send_header(k,v)
            self.end_headers()
            if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
                now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
                sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "GET {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" 304 0 "-" "-" 0.000000\\n')
            return

        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
        start=0
        end=size-1
        partial=False
        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
            spec=range_header[6:]
            if "-" in spec:
                s,e=spec.split("-",1)
                try:
                    if s=="" and e!="":
                        suffix=int(e)
                        if suffix<=size:
                            start=size-suffix
                            end=size-1
                            partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e=="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=size-1
                        partial=True
                    elif s!="" and e!="":
                        start=int(s)
                        end=int(e)
                        if start<size:
                            if end>=size:
                                end=size-1
                            partial=True
                except:
                    pass
        clen = end-start+1 if partial else size
        try:

            if partial:

                data=f.read(clen)
            else:

        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        mime=get_mime_type(str(file_path))
        disp="attachment" if file_path.name.startswith(".") or mime=="application/octet-stream" else "inline"
        if mime.startswith("text/") or "html" in mime:
            disp="inline"
        self.send_response(206 if partial else 200)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(clen))
        self.send_header("Content-Type", mime)
        self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f'{disp}; filename="{file_path.name}"')
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges","bytes")
        self.send_header("Last-Modified", last_mod)
        self.send_header("ETag", etag)
        self.send_header("Date", email.utils.formatdate(None, False, True))
        if partial:
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
        for k,v in self.server.config.get("custom_headers", []):
            if k.lower() not in ["content-length","content-type","content-disposition","accept-ranges","last-modified","etag","date","content-range","content-encoding"]:
                self.send_header(k,v)
        self.end_headers()
        if method!="HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(data)
        if self.server.config.get("verbose"):
            now=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z")
            sys.stderr.write(f'{now} [INFO] {self.client_address[0]} "{method} {raw_path_full} HTTP/1.1" {206 if partial else 200} {clen} "-" "-" 0.000000\n')

    def serve_directory(self, fs_path, effective_path, raw_path_full, query_flat, method):
        sort_method = query_flat.get("sort", self.server.config.get("default_sorting_method","name"))
        sort_order = query_flat.get("order", self.server.config.get("default_sorting_order","desc"))
        entries=[]
        for entry in os.scandir(fs_path):
            name=entry.name
            if not self.server.config.get("hidden") and name.startswith("."):
                continue
            if self.server.config.get("no_symlinks") and entry.is_symlink():
                continue
            is_dir = entry.is_dir()
            is_symlink = entry.is_symlink()
            symlink_target = None
            if is_symlink and self.server.config.get("show_symlink_info"):
                try:
                    symlink_target=os.readlink(entry.path)
                except:
                    pass
            try:
                st=entry.stat(follow_symlinks=True)
                sz=0 if is_dir else st.st_size
                mt=st.st_mtime
            except:
                sz=0
                mt=time.time()
            entries.append({"name":name,"is_dir":is_dir,"is_symlink":is_symlink,"symlink_target":symlink_target,"size":sz,"mtime":mt})

        def keyfunc(e):
            if sort_method=="size":
                return e["size"]
            elif sort_method=="date":
                return e["mtime"]
            else:
                return e["name"].lower()
        reverse = (sort_order=="desc")
        if self.server.config.get("dirs_first"):
            entries.sort(key=keyfunc, reverse=reverse)
            dirs=[e for e in entries if e["is_dir"]]

            for e in entries:
